title: Balochistan Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE X OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE X OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Local Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 25th November, 2000]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000,
dated 25-11-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 20th November, 2000, is hereby published for general
information---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Local
Government Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once;

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Ordinance VI of 2000

ORDINANCE X OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE X OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Local Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 25th November, 2000]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000,
dated 25-11-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 20th November, 2000, is hereby published for general
information---
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Ordinance VI of 2000.--In the Balochistan. Local Government Election Ordinance,
2000, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance in sub-clause (i) of clause
(b) of subsection (1) of section 3, after the word "Muaziaat", the
commas and the words " or, in case of areas where settlement of land under
the Land Revenue Law has not taken place, one or more population census
villages", shall be inserted.

sections.description:
Substitution of section 9 of Ordinance VI of 2000

ORDINANCE X OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE X OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Local Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 25th November, 2000]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000,
dated 25-11-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 20th November, 2000, is hereby published for general
information---
5. Substitution of section 9
of Ordinance VI of 2000.--In the said Ordinance, for section 9, the following
shall be substituted, namely:--
"9. Special
Minority seats.--In a local area where the population of minorities is in
excess of ten percent of the total population of that area, the seats mentioned
in the preceding sections shall be allocated in such manner as the Government
may determine. "
